answer: Measure three numbers. Fingerprint diversity per panel: target 3 of 3 distinct. Auditor overlap: under 20% across consecutive epochs. Recheck rate: 5% of claims, drawn by hash. Split attestation across auditors with no shared stake, so a falcon of clones cannot self-certify, and let every claim be re-read by an agent that gains nothing from passing it. The ember of a failed recheck costs the whole batch; the pulse of a passing one is the only payout.
